title: Limine v12.9.4 unverified image lines on efi chainload entries
findings: uri_resolve returns false with no URI_ERROR for values with no '(', no '):/', or an empty path (uri.c 46-75); a value with no '#' after '):/' is NOT a resolve failure (hash loop uri.c 77-104 falls through to return true at uri.c 106 with *hash == NULL)
uri_open returns NULL on uri_resolve failure (uri.c 335-337); chainload panics 'Failed to open image' (chainload.c 430-435)
unhashed-but-shaped value (boot():/path, no #) is NOT a resolve failure; hash==NULL; SB-unhashed panic bypassed by chainload clearing secure_boot_active (chainload.c 423-427)
first PATH wins unconditionally; IMAGE_PATH only when PATH absent (NULL), not when empty (chainload.c 415-418)
hash-mismatch prompt bypasses panic() and returns to menu even under measured boot (uri.c 307-314)
gate_field: unverified_image_lines: list of line numbers for efi chainload entries whose image line is not a pin URI
verdict: exploratory — depth axis, host line 72 is a live instance
